text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Valentine's Day.
The day you give chocolate to someone special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy was buzzing with excitement, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer, were you a good boy? If you were...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some of this chocolate~
Thank you for all your help this past year~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? It's not a year-end gift, but isn't this how Valentine's Day is done?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her actions were correct.
However, Wonder Acute hardly looked like
she was enjoying the event herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I could have just accepted it gratefully
and called it a day, but..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, they probably don't understand the point of the event. But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's not like Acute-san actually dislikes
events or anything. If anything...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “You're right. If we don't invite her, she'll look so lonely, saying, ‘Why didn't you let me join in~?’”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why it might be better
if the Trainer hypes her up instead!
She's not the type to get all fired up on her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After asking the two close friends, it became clear she didn't dislike events.
If so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn the tables and give them a present
to really liven things up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what is this business you have with me?
Ah, don't tell me it's about the chocolates from earlier...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Would you have preferred a fruit jelly assortment?
Or maybe a rice coupon...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, this package is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A Valentine's gift for me?
Getting one from someone who takes care of me
feels a little backwards, but...
choice_data_list: No, this works too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even if given from a Trainer to an Umamusume, there is no issue at all. And the contents are—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"A 'Luxury Kuzukiri Set'~?
A lavish Japanese sweet you can only get by going
to a department store's restaurant floor..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: O-O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuhoo!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Aaaah... I'm so sorry. I didn't expect to receive something like this, so I just...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And there are so many of them...
One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuhooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must have been thrilled. While trying to soothe her,
I encouraged her to eat, and...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, eating it right away would be such a waste,
how could anyone do that... That's why...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's enjoy it after
our daily training is done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —For several days thereafter.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Trainer...
I worked really hard today.
I really gave it my all. So~...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Kuzukiri! May I have some?
Just one from the fridge...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Ahhh... bless you.
Thank you so much. Ehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days were filled with nonstop smiles for quite a while.
It seems my modest reverse Valentine's gift
brought immense joy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whew... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding the bouquet she had just been handed,
Wonder Acute froze in place.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I tried speaking to her, but there was no real reaction.
After waiting for thirty seconds...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah... wa... a... aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: This is bad, this is real bad~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute ran out of the Trainer's Office, still clutching the bouquet of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Jordan-chan, Jordan-chan, we've got big trouble~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's that for?
Like a grand opening gift for some nail salon?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-chan, Nakayama-chan,
we've got big trouble~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That bouquet... I see.
Some legendary competitor is retiring, then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chased after her in a hurry—
and finally caught up to her on the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I... I just
don't know what to do anymore, ya know?
choice_data_list: Would you have preferred something edible?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's not it at all...
I'm just so moved to receive such a gorgeous bouquet...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My heart is just totally overwhelmed.
Ah, ah, aaaaaah~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She didn't look annoyed at all.
Receiving something she usually wouldn't,
she just looked genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Given her image of preferring plain things, not many people had given her bouquets before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Thank you...
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for such a wonderful gift...
I look forward to our continued relationship...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this response... feels a bit off, doesn't it? When receiving a gift, this should be the proper way, though...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Anyway... thanks a lot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spent Valentine's Day simply watching
a heartwarming Wonder Acute,
who wasn't quite sure how to return the favor.
